messages:
Sam: Heads-up HelioRetail signed a POC with a required production-like stress run. They want baseline of 300 QPS chat, bursts to 900 QPS for ~2-4 minutes during flash sales. Avg tokens in 90 / out 210 (300 total). Embeddings ~15% of calls. POC start Jun 20. Need sizing, reserved recommendation, autoscale recipe, preheat plan, and security bullets for procurement.

Ivy: Congrats. Quick clarifiers: are bursts overlapping across regions? expected p95 response length? model family preference?

Sam: Single region EU. They estimate p95 out tokens ~450 (so occasional long responses). Prefer 13B quant baseline but may ask to test a 30B distilled for quality.

Rahul: Ballpark math: peak_qps=900, tokens=300 -> tokens/sec=270k. If 13B_quant ~50k tps/GPU -> ~6 GPUs (270/50=5.4 -> 6). With p95 tails (longer outputs) throughput per GPU could drop ~25% -> recommend 8 GPUs as safe burst capacity. For steady baseline 300 QPS -> ~2 GPUs but reserve commit should provide headroom -> recommend commit=4 GPUs.

Morgan: Autoscale proposal: commit_reserve=4, min_reserved_pool=3, burst_limit=4 (max total 8), scale_step=1 GPU, cooldown=90s. Routing priority: reserved -> burst -> graceful queueing. Throttle threshold: pending queue > 150 or reserve utilization > 90% triggers burst spin-up.

Ivy: Preheat: persistent KV cache + two-phase warmup. 1) 8h background warm for top-500 prefixes 24h before flash. 2) targeted 30m preheat for top-20 customers before promo. This can cut decode load ~20-30% on hot sessions.

Sam: Pricing note for presales: ballpark reserved GPU/month ~$5.5k (13B equiv). Burst on-demand ~1.6x. So commit 4 GPUs -> ~$22k/mo baseline; bursting to 8 intermittently prorated. I'll flag finance for exact numbers and any volume discounts.

Rahul: Security bulleted answers for procurement: 1) EU region available; 2) SOC2 Type II report on request; 3) CMK/KMS supported in Private/VPC; hosted envelope encryption available; 4) audit logs default retention 90 days (extendable); 5) BAAs possible but requires legal review (5-10 business days). Also call out HSM/in-use encryption needs Private deployment and extra network prep.

Morgan: Ops guardrails: set model-fallback chain: 13B primary -> 30B-distill fallback for quality regressions only. Avoid latency-based fallback to higher-cost models. Add health monitors (p50/p95/p99 latencies, queue length, model-fallback count) and automatic rollback if error rate >0.5% or p95 >1.25x baseline for 5m.

infra-bot: preheat-scheduler: job created 2024-06-19T22:30Z for top-500 prefixes (duration 8h) and targeted preheat 2024-06-20T08:30Z (30m).

Sam: Action items recap: Rahul -> sizing slide + sensitivity table (13B vs 30B, seq-length effects) due EOD tomorrow; Morgan -> ops runbook + preheat checklist by tomorrow 10am; Ivy -> draft procurement bullets and legal intake for BAA; Sam -> assemble one-pager + attach to SOW.

Ivy: ack. Rahul: ack. Morgan: ack. Sam: thanks team, will update customer and request token-length histogram if they can share.
